statement.text:
Let R be the formal power series algebra in commuting indeterminates
x1 , . . . xn , . . . over the field with p elements, with p a prime. (Thus its elements are
(in general infinite) linear combinations of monomials xa1 1 . . . xann with n, a1 , . . . , an
non-negative integers.) Let I be the maximal ideal of R and J the (abstract) ideal
generated by all products of two elements of I. Is there an ideal U of R such that
U < I and U + J = I?
     If so, then SL3 (R) and the kernel of the map to SL3 (R/U ) provide an answer to
the previous question.                                                       John S. Wilson
